request.description:
## Register

Registers a new user account in the system.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
| --- | --- |
| `POST` | `{{base_url}}/auth/register` |

---

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | ✅ Yes |

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | `string` | ✅ Yes | A valid, unique email address for the new user |
| `username` | `string` | ✅ Yes | A unique display name for the new user |
| `password` | `string` | ✅ Yes | The account password (min. 8 characters recommended) |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "email": "example@example.com",
  "username": "Example",
  "password": "example123"
}
```

---

### Request Body Required

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | `string` | ✅ Yes |
| `username` | `string` | ✅ Yes |
| `password` | `string` | ✅ Yes |

All three fields are mandatory. Omitting any of them will result in a validation error.

---

### Response

**`201 Created`** — The user was successfully registered.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (UUID) | Unique identifier of the newly created user |
| `email` | `string` | Email address of the registered user |
| `username` | `string` | Username of the registered user |
| `created_at` | `string` (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of account creation |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "email": "example@example.com",
  "username": "Example",
  "created_at": "2026-09-17T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Missing or invalid fields in the request body |
| `409 Conflict` | A user with the given email or username already exists |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | Unexpected server error |

---

### Notes

- `email` and `username` must be unique across all users.
- Passwords are stored securely and should never be sent in plain text over unencrypted connections.
- No authentication is required to access this endpoint.

## Login

Authenticates an existing user and returns a pair of JWT tokens — `access_token` and `refresh_token`.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
| --- | --- |
| `POST` | `{{base_url}}/auth/login` |

---

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | ✅ Yes |

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | `string` | ✅ Yes | The registered email address of the user |
| `password` | `string` | ✅ Yes | The account password |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "email": "example@example.com",
  "password": "example123"
}

 ```

---

### Request Body Required

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | `string` | ✅ Yes |
| `password` | `string` | ✅ Yes |

Both fields are mandatory. Omitting either will result in a validation error.

---

### Response

**`200 OK`** — Authentication successful.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | `string` (JWT) | Short-lived token used to authorize subsequent requests |
| `refresh_token` | `string` (JWT) | Long-lived token used to obtain a new `access_token` |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "refresh_token": "dGhpcyBpcyBhIHJlZnJlc2ggdG9rZW4..."
}

 ```

---

### Post-Response Script

After a successful login, the following environment variables are automatically set by the post-response script:

| Variable | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `accessToken` | Value of `access_token` from the response |
| `refreshToken` | Value of `refresh_token` from the response |

These variables are used by other requests in the collection that require authentication via `Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Missing or invalid fields in the request body |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Incorrect email or password |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | Unexpected server error |

---

### Notes

- The `access_token` should be included in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer {{accessToken}}` for protected endpoints.
    
- Use the `refresh_token` to obtain a new `access_token` when it expires, without requiring the user to log in again.
    
- No authentication is required to access this endpoint.

## Refresh Token

Issues a new pair of JWT tokens — `access_token` and `refresh_token` — using a valid `refresh_token`. Use this endpoint when the `access_token` has expired to avoid requiring the user to log in again.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
| --- | --- |
| `POST` | `{{base_url}}/auth/refresh` |

---

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | ✅ Yes |

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following field:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refresh_token` | `string` (JWT) | ✅ Yes | A valid refresh token obtained from `/auth/login` or a previous `/auth/refresh` call |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "refresh_token": "{{refreshToken}}"
}
```

---

### Request Body Required

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `refresh_token` | `string` | ✅ Yes |

This field is mandatory. Omitting it will result in a validation error.

---

### Response

**`200 OK`** — Token refresh successful.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | `string` (JWT) | New short-lived token for authorizing subsequent requests |
| `refresh_token` | `string` (JWT) | New long-lived token to be used for the next refresh |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "refresh_token": "dGhpcyBpcyBhIHJlZnJlc2ggdG9rZW4..."
}
```

> ⚠️ The old `refresh_token` is invalidated after a successful refresh. Always use the latest token returned.

---

### Post-Response Script

After a successful refresh, the following environment variables are automatically updated by the post-response script:

| Variable | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `accessToken` | Value of `access_token` from the response |
| `refreshToken` | Value of `refresh_token` from the response |

These variables are used by other requests in the collection that require authentication via `Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Missing or malformed `refresh_token` in the request body |
| `401 Unauthorized` | The `refresh_token` is invalid or has expired |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | Unexpected server error |

---

### Notes

- The `refresh_token` is set automatically in the `{{refreshToken}}` environment variable after a successful `/auth/login` or `/auth/refresh` call.
- Each refresh issues a **new** `refresh_token` — the previous one becomes invalid (token rotation).
- No `Authorization` header is required for this endpoint.

## Logout

Invalidates the current `refresh_token`, effectively ending the user's session. After a successful logout, the token can no longer be used to obtain new access tokens.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
| --- | --- |
| `POST` | `{{base_url}}/auth/logout` |

---

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | ✅ Yes |

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following field:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refresh_token` | `string` (JWT) | ✅ Yes | The active refresh token to be invalidated |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "refresh_token": "{{refreshToken}}"
}
```

---

### Request Body Required

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `refresh_token` | `string` | ✅ Yes |

This field is mandatory. Omitting it will result in a validation error.

---

### Response

**`200 OK`** — Logout successful. The provided `refresh_token` has been invalidated.

> The response body may be empty or contain a confirmation message depending on the server implementation.

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Missing or malformed `refresh_token` in the request body |
| `401 Unauthorized` | The `refresh_token` is invalid or has already been invalidated |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | Unexpected server error |

---

### Notes

- After logout, the `{{refreshToken}}` environment variable will still hold the old (now invalid) token. Clear it manually if needed.
- The `access_token` is not invalidated server-side by this endpoint — it will remain valid until it naturally expires. Discard it on the client side after logout.
- No `Authorization` header is required for this endpoint — only the `refresh_token` in the request body.

---

## Create Ad

Creates a new ad listing in the system. Requires authentication via Bearer token.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
| --- | --- |
| `POST` | `{{base_url}}/ads` |

---

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | ✅ Yes |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{accessToken}}` | ✅ Yes |

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | ✅ Yes | The title of the advertisement |
| `description` | `string` | ❌ No | A detailed description of the ad |
| `price` | `integer` | ✅ Yes | The price associated with the ad |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "title": "Test title",
  "description": "Test description",
  "price": 1000
}
```

---

### Request Body Required

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | ✅ Yes |
| `price` | `integer` | ✅ Yes |
| `description` | `string` | ❌ No (optional) |

Omitting `title` or `price` will result in a validation error.

---

### Response

**`201 Created`** — The ad was successfully created.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (UUID) | Unique identifier of the created ad |
| `title` | `string` | Title of the ad |
| `description` | `string` | Description of the ad |
| `price` | `integer` | Price of the ad |
| `author` | `string` | Username or identifier of the creator |
| `created_at` | `string` (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of when the ad was created |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "id": "97010a4a-4b56-43a9-96c2-3c49111dd8b2",
  "title": "Test title",
  "description": "Test description",
  "price": 1000,
  "author": "Example",
  "created_at": "2026-09-17T12:16:13.7079175+03:00"
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Missing or invalid fields in the request body |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid `Authorization` token |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | Unexpected server error |

---

### Notes

- The `accessToken` is set automatically in the `{{accessToken}}` environment variable after a successful `/auth/login` or `/auth/refresh` call.
- If the token has expired, use `/auth/refresh` to obtain a new one before retrying.
- `description` is optional and can be omitted from the request body.

## Read Ads

Returns a list of all ad listings in the system. Requires authentication via Bearer token.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
| --- | --- |
| `GET` | `{{base_url}}/ads` |

---

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | ✅ Yes |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{accessToken}}` | ✅ Yes |

---

### Request Body

This endpoint does not require a request body.

---

### Response

**`200 OK`** — Returns an array of ad objects.

Each object in the array contains:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (UUID) | Unique identifier of the ad |
| `title` | `string` | Title of the ad |
| `description` | `string` | Description of the ad |
| `price` | `integer` | Price of the ad |
| `author` | `string` | Username or identifier of the creator |
| `created_at` | `string` (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of when the ad was created |

**Example:**

``` json
[
  {
    "id": "97010a4a-4b56-43a9-96c2-3c49111dd8b2",
    "title": "Test title",
    "description": "Test description",
    "price": 1000,
    "author": "Example",
    "created_at": "2026-09-17T12:16:13.7079175+03:00"
  }
]
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid `Authorization` token |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | Unexpected server error |

---

### Notes

- The `accessToken` is set automatically in the `{{accessToken}}` environment variable after a successful `/auth/login` or `/auth/refresh` call.
- If the token has expired, use `/auth/refresh` to obtain a new one before retrying.
- The response is an array and will be empty (`[]`) if no ads exist.
